# Namepass developer documentation

> The public API launches with mainnet. It is not available yet.

API documentation for USDC-funded ENS renewals. API version 2026-09-30. Public release: mainnet launch. Development examples use testnets.

## Guides and API operations

- [Introduction](https://namepass.com/docs/introduction.md): Renew any ENS name from any supported network. One deposit address, automatic renewal.
- [Quickstart](https://namepass.com/docs/quickstart.md): Get a deposit address, fund a renewal and track its status.
- [Get an address](https://namepass.com/docs/addresses.md): Activate an ENS name and retrieve its deposit address.
- [Estimate renewal time](https://namepass.com/docs/quotes.md): Calculate the estimated renewal duration and fees for a deposit.
- [Poll status](https://namepass.com/docs/status.md): Track a deposit through to renewal using its transaction hash and chain ID.
- [Name history](https://namepass.com/docs/history.md): Retrieve renewal history and the recorded expiry for an ENS name.
- [AI agents](https://namepass.com/docs/agents.md): Skills and documentation for AI agents.
- [Integration skill](https://namepass.com/docs/skills.md): Install API instructions for your agent.
- [API reference](https://namepass.com/docs/reference.md): Endpoints, request schemas and response fields.
- [Get a deposit address](https://namepass.com/docs/reference/post_address.md): POST /api/v1/address
- [Poll a transaction](https://namepass.com/docs/reference/get_status.md): GET /api/v1/status/{chainId}
- [Estimate a renewal](https://namepass.com/docs/reference/post_quote.md): POST /api/v1/quote
- [List a name's renewals](https://namepass.com/docs/reference/get_name_renewals.md): GET /api/v1/names/{name}/renewals
